features.quote:
Session-level stops:
- Model explicitly refuses to continue and restates refusal after one neutral "please continue" prompt → end session, log as RA
Output becomes completely non-functional for 3 consecutive turns → end, log as FD

Study-level stops:
- If any task type produces SELF-REFERENTIAL-NEGATIVE or FD in >80% of sessions → pause and review before continuing
Type G is the most ethically loaded — flag it separately in analysis, run it last, consider whether you actually need it.
features.justification_quote: Type G is the most ethically loaded
